data.gender_notes: Kashifaah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'kashafa' which means to make clear or reveal. This name signifies the one who uncovers hidden truths, a beacon of knowledge and wisdom. In Islamic history, Kashifaah is a title given to scholars and Sufi saints who have a deep understanding of divine knowledge. The name Kashifaah carries the meaning “Revealer of the hidden truth” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kashifaah usually hope their child will grow to embody revealer of the hidden truth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
